sourceFile: 25.1 MSU-L20S15-07 Result check NTI lot test New Bond SJ4774 and VE562850- 2025.06.17_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not usable because it misses the Normal vs SJ4774/VE562850 lot comparison and includes noisy metric groupings.
issues: Changed factor is filename-based, not source-based.
Baseline and changed conditions are marked not explicit despite clear Normal/SJ4774/VE562850 rows.
Outcome metrics include many parsed numeric row artifacts.
Some cited rows are not shown in review context or do not support grouping.
STD role is not separated from Normal baseline context.
requiredUserQuestions: Should SJ4774 and VE562850 be treated as separate test lots against Normal?
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to NTI/New Bond lot comparison.
Use Normal as baseline and SJ4774, VE562850 as changed conditions.
Keep STD as reference context only unless proven baseline.
Limit outcomes to SPL, Fo, and THD summary metrics plus valid raw spectra if needed.
Remove numeric artifact subresults and unsupported row citations.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are insufficient for final evidence until regrouped around source-supported condition rows.
